About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

About the Company

Koru UX Design is a leading UX design agency specializing in HealthTech. We partner with clients to deliver user-centered design solutions that drive innovation and enhance user experiences. Our design teams work as an integrated extension of our client’s teams, deeply embedding ourselves into their processes to create seamless, impactful products.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior UX Researcher who thrives on complex problem spaces and is comfortable driving research in ambiguity. At Koru, your insights won’t just sit in reports—they’ll directly influence real enterprise products across healthcare, automation, and finance.

You’ll plan and execute end-to-end research studies, work closely with product owners, and help define experiences used by thousands of professionals in the US.

Location: Pune / Remote

Experience: 3–6 years

Type: Full-time

What You’ll Do

  • Own and lead UX research activities across discovery, concept validation, and usability phases
  • Plan, conduct, and synthesise user interviews, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, and journey mapping
  • Create actionable outputs like personas, user journeys, service blueprints, and research reports
  • Proactively identify users to talk to—whether through clients, internal teams, or customer success
  • Translate research insights into product opportunities and design inputs
  • Collaborate with UX designers, product managers, and front-end teams throughout the design process
  • Help shape our research practice as we scale, including mentoring junior team members when needed
  • Proactively identify new opportunities for research within existing client engagements to extend project reach

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–6 years of hands-on UX research experience (not internships or academic)
  • Direct experience conducting research for enterprise or B2B products (SaaS, healthcare, platforms, or internal tools)
  • Comfort working with US-based users and stakeholders, and ability to adapt research communication accordingly
  • Strong system-level thinking: you can map workflows, identify gaps, and untangle complex journeys
  • Ability to handle open-ended, ambiguous briefs—you’re someone who finds ways to start and drive the process
  • Familiarity with creating journey maps, service blueprints, or ecosystem maps
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with a knack for explaining research to cross-functional teams

Bonus Points If You Have

    • Experience working in healthcare, automation, or other complex, high-stakes domains
    • Exposure to continuous discovery practices alongside product teams
    • Comfort engaging with product owners and client stakeholders to shape research direction and priorities

Benefits

  • Opportunities for growth and continuous learning (LinkedIn learning & professional trainings).
  • Flexible working hours and remote options.
  • A collaborative and innovative team culture.
  • Opportunity for career growth and leadership roles.

As a UI/UX Researcher & Designer at Intelerad, you will play a meaningful role in shaping how clinicians and healthcare professionals interact with our medical imaging products. You will independently own research and design for one or more product areas, partnering with product managers, developers, and end users to turn complex clinical needs and business goals into intuitive, high-quality experiences, from early discovery through to successful release. You will bring a balanced skillset, grounding design decisions in rigorous user research, translating insight into compelling, usable interfaces, and helping raise the quality of UX practice across the team.

Key Responsibilities

Research

  • Independently plan and lead qualitative and quantitative UX research across the product lifecycle, using field studies, direct observation, interviews, workflow and task analysis, usability testing, and surveys to identify opportunities, validate assumptions, and shape product direction.

  • Set research priorities and methodologies for your product area in partnership with product management; recruit participants and moderate sessions with clinicians and other end users.

  • Synthesize research data into personas, journey maps, and actionable insights, and translate findings into design and product recommendations that influence roadmap decisions.

  • Own and evolve our research repository so findings stay discoverable and continue to inform current and future work.

Design

  • Lead the design of intuitive interfaces from concept to release, grounded in a strong understanding of user goals, clinical workflows, and product requirements, delivering screen layouts, interaction patterns, and UI elements that meet usability and business standards.

  • Own design work end-to-end: produce wireframes, storyboards, functional prototypes, and detailed specifications that clearly communicate intent to developers, QA, and technical writers.

  • Drive the creation and adoption of design standards that ensure consistency across the product suite, and guide developers through UI design decisions and trade-offs during implementation.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Build trust with users through deep empathy, active listening, and strong facilitation, enabling a thorough understanding of their goals, workflows, and challenges.

  • Present design and research findings clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to product leadership, and lead design and research critique sessions to ensure alignment and quality.

  • Mentor and provide feedback to less experienced designers and researchers, sharing methods and best practices across the team.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), User Experience (UX) Design, Interaction Design, Human Factors / Ergonomics, Psychology, Graphic Design, or equivalent experience.

  • 4+ years of experience in UI/UX design and UX research, with a portfolio demonstrating both strong web and mobile design capabilities and end-to-end research work.

  • Proficiency in industry-standard design tools, including Figma and/or Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD, or equivalent).

  • Demonstrated expertise in wireframing, prototyping, and producing design specifications.

  • Demonstrated experience independently planning and leading user research using qualitative and quantitative methods, and synthesizing findings into personas, journey maps, and actionable insights.

  • Familiarity with UX research tools and repositories (e.g., Dovetail, UserZoom, Optimal Workshop, or similar).

  • Strong knowledge of HCI principles and design best practices.

  • Proven ability to communicate design rationale and research findings effectively to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders.

  • Excellent spoken and written English, or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience prototyping with HTML and CSS or similar front-end tools.

  • Experience in healthcare IT or complex enterprise software; experience conducting research with clinical or healthcare users.

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices.

  • Familiarity with survey design and basic statistical analysis.

  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

  • Experience mentoring or informally guiding other designers or researchers.

  • No direct supervisory responsibilities.

Travel Requirements

  • None

ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Senior User Experience (UX) Researcher, Mixed Methods with a passion for uncovering customer insights and a track record of turning research into real product influence. Your focus will span the full product lifecycle, combining generative, evaluative, and quantitative research to build a holistic picture of our customers. You'll be part of our UX Research team, where we help onX build a deep, ongoing understanding of our customers, so product decisions are grounded in how people actually explore the outdoors with onX, helping our teams build with confidence. This is a great opportunity to be part of a dynamic, growing company focused on making an impact on the business, and to shape how onX understands its customers at the moments that matter most. This role will serve as the link between what we learn from onX customers and how product and business teams act on it. This role will report to the UX Research Manager.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

Own end-to-end research

  • Independently plan and run research, both qualitative and quantitative, across the full product lifecycle to shape strategy and sharpen the onX customer experience.
  • Know which method fits which question, and bring sound judgment to every call you make: balancing speed with rigor, weighing tradeoffs honestly, and making decisions that keep your conclusions credible and your team confident in them.

Build cross-functional partnerships and influence to scale impact

  • Build deep knowledge of our customers and products so you can spot the right questions before anyone asks, challenge assumptions, and help shape product strategy and priorities.
  • Build close, trusted relationships with Product, Design, and other partners from day one — understanding their goals and context well enough to spot research opportunities together and scope studies collaboratively, not just deliver findings at the end.
  • Turn research into clear next steps — tell a compelling story with your findings and partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Business Intelligence, and Marketing to inform decisions.
  • Act as a go-to advisor when partners are running their own research by weighing in on study design and methodology to help strengthen their approach.
  • Coach non-researchers, contribute to shared research standards and practices, and look for ways AI can make our research faster, sharper, and easier to reuse.

Execute across mixed methods

  • Use qualitative methods like interviews, usability testing, diary studies, and other generative and evaluative approaches.
  • Design and execute quantitative studies, using descriptive and inferential statistics to turn survey, behavioral, and CX data into clarity we can act on. You'll also help shape how we measure UX more broadly, so teams understand how well our products serve customers at scale.
  • Know when one approach fits better than the other, and when combining them gets you further — for example, working through a multi-phase study where each builds on the other to answer a bigger question.
  • Continuously integrate qualitative, quantitative, and behavioral data to spot patterns, make sense of conflicting signals, and build a fuller picture of onX customers and how their needs and experiences change over time.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • A portfolio, work samples, or case studies is required as part of the application.
    • It should demonstrate your ability to independently scope and execute mixed-method research and translate evidence into meaningful product and business impact.
  • Eight (8) years of relevant experience, that includes at least five (5) years in UX, product, or consumer research, preferably in a fast-paced B2C product environment
  • A Bachelor’s degree, Master’s degree, or PhD in Psychology, Human Factors, Human-Computer Interaction, Anthropology, or related field or equivalent experience.
  • A proactive, strategic mindset. You understand customers, the product, and the business well enough to know what's worth researching.
  • Strong communication and collaboration. You explain findings, implications, and limitations clearly to any audience, and build real partnerships with Product, Design, and other cross-functional partners along the way.
  • Proven mixed-methods research fluency, with the ability to independently design, execute, analyze, and integrate qualitative and quantitative studies to answer strategic questions.
  • Experience across foundational and evaluative qualitative methods, including interviews, usability testing, diary studies, and other generative and evaluative approaches.
  • Hands-on quantitative research experience, including survey design and analysis, sampling strategies, data-quality assessment, and applying descriptive and inferential statistics.
  • Experience with UX measurement and Voice of Customer (VoC) practices, and interest in helping that work evolve and scale.
  • Ability to juggle multiple research efforts at once, and adjust as questions, timelines, or business needs shift.
  • A strong curiosity for exploring new technologies, including AI.
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel quarterly for multiple days to a corporate office or other onX strategic location, such as a Basecamp.

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience working in a democratized or enabled research environment
  • Experience with data analysis or visualization tools like R or Python
  • Proficiency with advanced statistics like regression, factor analysis, cluster analysis, etc.
  • Expertise with advanced survey methods like MaxDiff, conjoint, Van Westendorp pricing or similar
  • Genuine enthusiasm for the outdoors and how people explore it

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX has created a thriving distributed workforce designed to foster connection, collaboration, and shared experience across several US locations. We have two HQ locations in Bozeman and Missoula, MT and established virtual workforce Basecamps in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $154,000 and $180,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
  • Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
  • Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays
